prs.title: SEP-2350: accumulate scopes on step-up auth
prs.author: dogacancolak
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: client_metadata.scope is unconditionally overwritten by get_client_metadata_scopes() instead of being merged with existing values. In #2373 this fires in the 401/initial-discovery path (Step 3), clobbering scope the caller set explicitly. Both PRs change the same assignment pattern — `self.context.client_metadata.scope = get_client_metadata_scopes(...)` — and both fix the same class of symptom: scope values that were set earlier in the flow are silently lost. members.reason: [llm] cluster primary: client_metadata.scope is unconditionally overwritten by get_client_metadata_scopes() instead of being merged with existing values. In #2373 this fires in the 401/initial-discovery path (Step 3), clobbering scope the caller set explicitly. In #2676 it fires in the 403/insufficient_scope step-up path (Step 2a), clobbering previously accumulated scopes that should survive the challenge. Both PRs change the same assignment pattern — `self.context.client_metadata.scope = get_client_metadata_scopes(...)` — and both fix the same class of symptom: scope values that were set earlier in the flow are silently lost. (2 PRs)

members.title: fix(shared): preserve MCPError payload on pickle
members.author: MukundaKatta
members.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Python's default pickle reconstruction calls cls(*self.args), but MCPError.__init__ stores only the message string in self.args (via super().__init__(error.message)), so unpickling crashes because __init__ expects an ErrorData object. UrlElicitationRequiredError has an additional mismatch: its constructor signature (elicitations, message=None) doesn't match the stored args at all. (2 PRs)

members.title: fix: don't send a response for cancelled requests
members.author: Zelys-DFKH
members.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Both fix protocol compliance for request cancellation by modifying RequestResponder.cancel() in session.py. #2493 removes the incorrect error-response send from cancel() and patches server/lowlevel/server.py to suppress responses for cancelled requests. #2514 adds the affirmative spec-required CancelledNotification send in the same cancel() method.
